projects.name: Upscale nutrition sensitive climate smart programme such as home grown school feeding
projects.description: Support small-holder farmers with climate smart solutions to stimulate increased production for purpose of supplying local and national markets including school based meals. The goal is to supply schools with fresh vegetables from nearby farmers all year round to improve the nutritional quality of meals served to children in schools.

projects.name: Strengthen science-based policymaking for increased impact towards the SDGs by assessing key environmental issues and providing focused outlooks
projects.description: Assessing key environmental issues and providing focused outlooks to strengthen science-based policy and decision making aims to identify environmental challenges and opportunities for sustainable development, while strengthening the science-policy interface to support regional, national and local governments, the business sector, and civil society including non-governmental organizations and local community groups (women, men and children). The project’s approach will be integrated, inclusive and evidence-based, ensuring scientific robustness and credibility, policy-neutral legitimacy and enhanced transparency.

children.name: Promoting Sustainable and Inclusive Economic Growth
children.description: By 2025, women, men and youth including marginalized persons contribute to and benefit from economic progress, through greater access to decent employment, equitable social economic opportunities, sustainable enterprise opportunities as well as resilient, financially sustainable social protection systems

children.name: Development of policy, regulatory and incentive frameworks for an enabling environment for business supported
children.description:
1.1. Develop inclusive sector development program agreements in agricultural sector for all value chains.
1.2. Build capacity for development of policy and legislative instruments to attract investment .
1.3. Support stakeholder engagement to facilitate inclusion and participation of all groups inlc. women & youth

children.name: Institutions and capacities for delivery of effective and responsive social protection systems strengthened
Institutions and capacities for delivery of effective and responsive social protection systems strengthened
children.description:
2.1. Improve institutional capacities to develop costed policies and plans in social protection is strengthened.
2.2. Conduct assessments of social protection programs are conducted to rationalize support.
2.3. Develop a harmonized legal framework for social protection policies and laws.
2.4. Strengthen multisectional coordination of social protection programs

children.name: Economic data incl. labor market statistics and information systems and reporting on SDG Global Indicator Framework
children.description:
3.1. Set up platform for mobilization of support from DFI, Climate finance and other sources.
3.2. Support the establishment and review of policy for national data systems for reporting on SDGs.
3.3. Support production of analytical products, poverty impacts and fiscal policies incl building capacity on financial assessments.

children.name: Institutions and capacities of govt at national and sub-national level to plan, implement and monitor policy frameworks as well to deploy incentives and measures to stimulate investment in the economy is strengthened
children.description:
4.1. Build capacity of govt to design and implement effective policies, strategies, and legal framework to support  economic growth
4.2. Support production of analytical products and poverty impacts of growth and fiscal policies.
4.3. Support institutionalization and capacity building of an Informal Sector coordination forum/ Agency.

children.name: Investing in Human Resources and Social Development
children.description: By 2025, boys, girls, women and men, especially the most vulnerable benefit from equitable access to inclusive, gender transformative, effective and efficient quality social services, life-long learning and market relevant - skills

children.name: Quality teaching and learning is improved and made accessible including through diversified remote and web-based learning platforms at all levels
children.description:
3.1. Institutionalization of distance earning for primary and secondary levels. 
3.2. Build the capacity of educators to provide quality education, including life skills education (LSE).
3.3. Support education management information system (EMIS) to provide timely, quality  gender disaggregated data.
3.4. Support informal education for out of school children and youth.
3.5. Improve access to education at secondary level.

children.name: Policy and legislative environment is strengthened to provide multisectoral, coordination and financing for quality education services at all levels
children.description: This output will create an enabling policy and legislative environment to provide multisectoral, coordination and financing for quality education services at all levels.

children.name: Inclusive Agri-Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Systems Strengthened
children.description: Enabling environment and systems strengthened to support inclusive agricultural economic growth, decent employment, and sustainable livelihoods, with increased opportunities for women, youth, and vulnerable groups in agri-entrepreneurship.

children.name: Institutional capacities to develop costed plans and policies in the health sector is strengthened
children.description: Building capacity to develop, review, operationalize and implement policies, Generate evidence to inform policy, planning and programming for health services or interventions, Strengthen capacity of service providers and Conduct program reviews

children.name: Communities empowered to demand quality, relevant health, nutrition, HIV and NCDs care
children.description:
2.1. Conduct community engagements to promote uptake of health service for vulnerable and most at risk populations.
2.2. Build capacity on preparedness and response for health.

children.name: Accountable Governance, Justice and Human Rights
children.description: By 2025, oversight bodies and government and institutions at national and regional levels operate in an independent, participatory and accountable manner, ensuring equal access to justice and services, with a systematic, participatory implementation and reporting mechanism for human rights obligations and SDGs, with a focus on leaving no one behind

children.name: The capacity of civil society organizations, oversight bodies and government at national and regional levels is strengthened for good governance and human rights
children.description:
1.1. Build capacity of National Referral Mechanisms (NMRF) to coordinate and report on SDGs.
1.2. Develop legislation/policies to promote human rights and good governance.
1.3. Build the capacity of the Eswatini Human Rights and Public Administration Commission, Parliament, Civil Society, Religious and traditional leaders.
1.4. Build the capacity of institutions to utilize the NMR for victims of trafficking.

children.name: The capacity of rights-holders, particularly women, children and other vulnerable groups, to participate in decision-making processes, claim their rights, access justice and seek redress is strengthened.
children.description:
2.1. Provide support to CSO to engage all populations incl vulnerable people and people living with disability in human rights issues
2.2.  Establish service centers at community level for ease of access to vital services incl. birth registration, shelters for victims of trauma and/ or GBV.

children.name: Strengthened multi-sectoral capacity to prevent and respond to violence and discrimination against women, girls, boys and other vulnerable groups
children.description:
3.1. Strengthening civic education on laws and public participation.
3.2. Strengthen capacity for multisectoral coordination and data generation systems on violence.
3.3. Build capacity to coordinate and respond and prevent violence.

children.description: By 2025, Eswatini is on an inclusive low carbon development pathway that is resilient, to climate change and in which natural resources are managed sustainably and community adaption to climate change is enhanced for improved livelihoods, health and food security especially for vulnerable and marginalized communities
